hypothesis: The BatchNorm-heavy temporal encoder under-retains between-subject amplitude and distribution cues that explain much of H1's advantage. A small normalization-free learnable convolution bank followed only by mean/std pooling of its learned feature maps will improve stable inner-CV performance.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only if mean balanced accuracy improves by at least 0.01, improves in at least 9 of 15 matched folds, and AUROC and calibration do not materially regress. Otherwise reject this branch and stop moment-branch expansion.
